title: Sector Critical
description: Sector Critical was my first attempt at releasing a fully developed game as a solo developer. The game was a multiplayer VR title designed for Google Daydream, running smoothly with only 22 setpass calls. It features multiple ships, weapons, and abilities. Unfortunately, it never passed Google’s design requirements due to limitations in their multiplayer API, which they never updated to meet their own design restrictions. Like many of Google’s products, Daydream was discontinued prematurely, leaving the game 90% complete.
